mapper.insert: INSERT INTO post (user_id, post_title, post_content, post_date, post_count, post_like_count, post_img, target_type, target_id) VALUES (#{user_id}, #{post_title}, #{post_content}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{post_count}, #{post_like_count}, #{post_img}, #{targetType}, #{targetId})
mapper.update: UPDATE post SET post_title = #{post_title}, post_content = #{post_content}, post_img = #{post_img}, target_type = #{targetType}, target_id = #{targetId} WHERE post_id = #{post_id}
